title: Fats Waller's first big band at the Apollo
summary: Thomas recalls working with Fats Waller's band out of the Arcadia, its first theater date at the Apollo with Johnny Hamilton, and a confused sequence of Turner, Henderson and Waller.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom
story.community_name: Bessie, Mamie, Ma Rainey: the classic blues queens

blocks.x: There was an interlude there, Stan. But, a tremendous guy, Fats Waller.
You worked with him?
Yeah, I worked with Fats. That band out of the Arcadia.
Well, where did you go with him?
Well, we did his first theater date. ... Bugs about Johnny Hamilton. I met him way back in Missouri. He's Fats' favorite trumpet player.
He was good, too.
A very fine trumpet player. So, he had an idea and he decided that Fats should have a big band so -- incidentally, I met a man who's around 82.
You met who?

A young man by the name of, he's around 82 by the name of Ed Kirkety in a jazz museum. I think you introduced him to me, you know. And we had a, that's Ellington's theater reunion temple (?) so at our first theater date and ...
It was the Apollo

And the tremendous thing I think about Fats and I always think thing about, too, you know there comes a time when you get a few places and people say, well, yeah, yeah, you know. Well, I always admired him, you know. I always admired Fats. He's a tremendous musician, tremendous personality. So during the rehearsal I guess we jumped in there from like a one night stand, you know 4 or 500 miles, rehearsal ... 5 o'clock in the morning, you open at 11, you get a chance to breathe.
But where did you join that wm?
No, no, at the Appollo.
Oh, at the Apollo.
Yeah. We took the whole band over. See, he took Charlie Turner's band over.
Well, you haven't been with Charlie Turner then, have you?
Yes. (actually said Umm)
Oh, you went back to Charlie Turner after Thurman Fermor Papp?

No, let me see. I might have the time mixed up, Stanley. Sometimes, No, after Henderson I got my card (something about Charlie getting his card) then they had another band. Shorty had this band going to the Apollo (end of Tape 1, Side 2)
